description: This file defines a database migration class for the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system, specifically for version 4.6.0. It includes logic to create several internationalization-related database tables, set up foreign key and unique constraints, and insert initial language and group data. It also modifies menu items within the application's administrative interface. The class extends an abstract migration class and mainly contains methods to perform database schema changes and data insertion.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A database migration class that sets up internationalization tables, constraints, and menu modifications for OrangeHRM version 4.6.0.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration by creating tables, adding constraints, and inserting initial data.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of this migration, '4.6'.

methods.name: readlanguageYaml
methods.description: Reads YAML content from a file and returns it as an array, used for loading language and group data.

methods.name: insertLanguages
methods.description: Inserts language records into the 'ohrm_i18n_language' table based on parsed YAML data.

methods.name: insertGroups
methods.description: Inserts group records into the 'ohrm_i18n_group' table based on parsed YAML data.
